name: Drafting the ward drainage motion for mock parliament
subject: debate
brief: In the Class XI humanities mock parliament, your bench of three is tabling a private member's motion on monsoon lane drainage: the main motion text, the financial memorandum, and the oral opening question. You are the scribe writing out the clean copy, and the recess bell rings in a few minutes.

tasks.name: Draft the three operative clauses of the motion
Prepare the one-paragraph municipal outlay note
Frame the two-minute oral opening question

facts.text: The student Speaker closes the notice box at 1:15 p.m. sharp before lunch, not at the start of fifth period
Nasrin has a bookmarked copy of the mock parliament standing orders

note: Set in the humanities stream at Nabapara Vidyalaya (loc_nhss). The deadline constraint is the 1:15 p.m. notice-box closure known to Arup; the seam is that the motion clauses cite Ward 14 while the financial note cites Ward 11.
